ratings_why.fun: The save-then-splurge rhythm gives real spike turns, but most payoffs are plain +1/+1 packets and the Hive half mostly asks you to sit on gold.
ratings_why.distinct: Reading your own gold two ways (kept versus spent) plays unlike any of today's tribes, and Fennimore, Gate Guard and Tettix bend shop rules in fresh ways.

verdict_why: Tithonus's extra Hoard pass, stacked with Mother Melissa, still can't be resolved from the card text; that is a real fix.

points.text: Tithonus's 'Splurge: your Hoard effects trigger once more' doesn't say whether the extra pass still needs each threshold, or how it stacks with Mother Melissa's twice/three times. Say 'each Hoard that fires triggers one more time' and give the order: Splurge first, then Hoard.
Signora Afide's second trigger is a sum (half Attack, then 1 gold per 3, up to 3). A flat 'loses half her Attack; you gain 2 gold' reads at a glance and keeps the milking picture.

Ottavia is the seed's waggle dancer but just buffs the Hive on a Splurge. Let the dance point somewhere: her Splurge buffs the Hive units on one side of her, and you choose the side by where you put her.
The winter cluster, the seed's best bee picture, is missing. A Hive unit that shares its Hoard buff along touching Hive units, or swaps to the outer edge in a fight, would bring it on board.
Fête Barker's 'leftmost other unit' on two staggered rows: say it uses reading order (F1 first), as Hedgerow's 'rightmost' presumably does, so who leads the parade is obvious.

standouts.why: Gate Guard is the barbed sting in one line: your bank becomes one big hit and then the bee dies. Clear and true to the animal.
Lord Fennimore, thrown out and back every turn a bit bigger, is the drone's story told by the sell button.
Maestro Tettix turns Tier up into a party: a single rule that makes the climb itself a Splurge.

weakest.why: Old Messor is 'keep 3 gold, get +1/+1': it works, but there is nothing to see or decide.
Cluster Nurse is a plain Hoard team buff; the name promises the winter cluster but the text doesn't show it.
Ottavia's text has nothing of the dance or the scouting, so the crossing card feels like a generic buffer.

flags.note: The extra Hoard pass has no stated threshold rule or order against Mother Melissa's multiplier.
With Tithonus, one 20-gold Splurge can fire every Hoard four times; hot on purpose, worth the owner's eye.
Tettix plus Madame Cigale makes each Refresh after base gold a big all-board buff.
Golden Mask-Maker hands two Shells per Splurge, which can make triples on demand.
